text: ICHTHYGLUG'S SONG Welcome to my grotto! Call me king of the cray. Ichthyglug’s my name— I’'m the catch of the day. The ocean’s my oyster. The waves are mine to rule. Ichthyglug’s my name— Baddest fish in the school. I’'m current. I'm the tide. I’ll rain on your parade. Ichthyglug’s my name— I’'m the siren’s serenade. I’ll drown you in riches. I might go overboard. Ichthyglug’s my name— But please call me “my lord.”
